title: 108. Combination Sum

examples.explanation: All combinations from [2, 3, 6, 7] that sum to 7 are [[2,2,3],[7]].
Candidates may be reused any number of times.

hints: Sort the candidates so a branch can stop once the next value exceeds the remaining target.
Backtrack with a start index to avoid generating permutations of the same combination.
When choosing a candidate, recurse with the same index because that value may be reused.
